incumbentRule: Every source in the accepted precondition is preserved by an additive admission.
additionRule: A digest-title identity is reused when its provider-bound title is already present, otherwise it is uploaded once.
retirementRule: No source retirement is authorized by this policy; retirement requires a separate explicit collection-level decision and contract.
liveActivationRequires: an observe-live receipt for the current notebook source IDs and titles
